title: Lovely Smoky Polish Turkey Mince Casserole
description: A comforting Polish dish featuring turkey mince, smoke, and satvik-friendly ingredients, with a winey and crumbly texture.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
In a large pan, heat the oil over medium heat and saute the onion, carrot, and celery until they are soft.
Add the turkey mince and cook until it is browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the white wine and tomato paste, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the liquid has reduced by half.
In a separate bowl, mix the oat flour with a little water to form a crumbly mixture.
Transfer the turkey mixture to a baking dish and top with the crumbly oat mixture.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
